proposal.root_cause: Projection width is guessed from question wording, so 'which entities' questions get name-only SELECTs where gold returns the full joined row set
proposal.what: Replace the vague 'return all columns of the main table' rule with a concrete projection-width policy: for entity-listing questions (Which/What/List/Show/Find + plural entity noun) that do not enumerate attributes, select every column of every joined table in FROM order (T1.*, T2.*), and only narrow to named attributes when the question explicitly lists them; superlative/count/rank questions keep the minimal asked-for projection. This targets sp0755 (gold = country.* + countrylanguage.*) without touching literal matching or the repair loop.
